title: Fix website stability and correct default site content

requirements.text: Perform a full production smoke-test of the marketing site (Home view) and Admin view and fix any runtime errors, broken navigation, or broken section scrolling so the website works reliably end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading the site shows the Home view without uncaught exceptions in the browser console.
Header navigation links scroll to the correct sections (Hero/Services/About/Contact) on the Home view.
Switching to the Admin view via hash route (/#/admin) renders the AdminPage without runtime errors and can return back to Home view.
No broken links or obviously broken UI states are present during normal navigation.

requirements.text: Update the Motoko backend default `SiteContent` values so that a fresh deploy (or empty state) shows Legend Techno Solutions-specific copy (hero/services/about/contact + business hours) instead of generic business placeholder text.
acceptanceCriteria: `backend/main.mo` `defaultSiteContent()` returns headings/subheadings/descriptions and business hours that match the Legend Techno Solutions website domain (computer/laptop repair, CCTV installation, networking).
On a clean state (no admin edits applied), `getSiteContent()` returns the updated Legend Techno Solutions defaults.
Frontend Home view shows Legend Techno Solutions-appropriate default copy when backend content has not been customized by an admin.

requirements.text: Ensure the application build and deploy pipeline completes successfully for both frontend and backend, and fix any configuration/build issues that prevent successful deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: A full project build completes without errors.
A deployment completes successfully and the deployed site loads in a browser.
Core flows function on the deployed site: Home view renders, Contact form is interactive (when actor is ready), and Admin view route loads.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; create `backend/migration.mo` only if a state migration is actually required.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Redesigning the website theme or changing marketing content beyond correcting the backend default SiteContent to match the existing Legend Techno Solutions domain.
Adding new pages, new service categories, or new backend features unrelated to fixing stability/build/deploy and correcting default content.
